summaries.title: Offline Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning Scales to Large Models
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Offline Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning Scales** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖尺度定律（Scaling Law）。核心论点主张：We introduce a Perceiver-based actor-critic model and elucidate the key model features needed to make offline RL work with self- and cross-attention modules。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We find that offline actor-critic algorithms can outperform strong, supervised, behavioral cloning baselines for multi-task training on a large dataset containing...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We show that offline actor-critic reinforcement learning can scale to large models - such as transformers - and...；Overall, we find that: i) simple offline actor critic algorithms are a natural choice for gradually moving away...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 5 赞），本工作为突破 **训练与强化学习** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
